basic_details.offering_entity: Faculty of Science, KU Leuven & Science@Leuven Fund
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: KU Leuven (Katholieke Universiteit Leuven, Flanders, Belgium)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Exclusively open to English Master's programs of the KU Leuven Faculty of Science: Master of Astronomy & Astrophysics, Biology, Biophysics/Biotechnology, Chemistry, Geography, Geology, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics & Data Science, and Sustainable Development.
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition without country quotas (typically 1 to 3 Pakistani awardees annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 academic years (Year 2 renewal contingent on achieving distinction in Year 1 examinations)

nationality_requirements: International students from all non-EEA countries
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed undergraduate degree (Bachelor's, 16 years education) with outstanding graduation grades, belonging to the top 10% of their graduating class.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Belgian equivalent of 'Distinction' or 'Great Distinction' (at least 15/20 or CGPA 3.60+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate training in pure or applied sciences, physics, chemistry, mathematics, or biology corresponding to target program.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final undergraduate year graduating prior to autumn semester.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Must not have previously studied or worked at KU Leuven.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; laboratory research experience and thesis projects are decisive.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 overall (with min 6.5 in all subcomponents) or TOEFL iBT min 94 (with min 22 in all subcomponents). MOI letters strictly not accepted.

eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite pure science and mathematics scholars.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not have previously studied at KU Leuven.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition fee waiver for the Faculty of Science Master's program.

admission_application_fee.details: Application fee of €75 paid by applicant via KU Leuven online admissions system.

accommodation.details: Paid out of scholarship award; assistance in securing KU Leuven residence hall accommodation (Kot).

monthly_stipend.details: Scholarship amount up to €12,000 per academic year, which covers basic living expenses and health insurance for 1 academic year (~€1,000/month).

airfare.details: International travel costs borne by the applicant.

visa_fee.details: Belgian administrative visa fee (€220) and embassy processing charges paid by applicant.

health_insurance.details: Basic Belgian health insurance (Christelijke Mutualiteit / CM or Partenamut) premium covered under scholarship grant.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized meals at KU Leuven Alma student restaurants (~€4 to €6 per meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Access to top laboratory facilities, supercomputers (VSC), and digital libraries.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Access to departmental scientific research funds during master's thesis research.

university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #63 QS World University Rankings 2025; Top 50 in Times Higher Education (THE #45); #1 in Europe for innovation.
available_majors: Physics, Astronomy & Astrophysics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biophysics, Biochemistry & Biotechnology, Biology, Geography, Geology, Statistics & Data Science, Sustainable Development
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree in pure science, mathematics, or physics with exceptional GPA.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Physics, Astronomy, and Statistics are among the most competitive programs in Europe.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Upload the PDF screenshot of your completed KU Leuven Master's application into the Science@Leuven portal before February 15.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Apply for the MSc program at KU Leuven admissions application portal. Step 2: Register on Science@Leuven scholarship portal and upload the confirmation.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Submit Master's application via KU Leuven admissions application tool.
3. Take a screenshot or PDF of the submitted application confirmation.
4. Fill out the dedicated Science@Leuven scholarship web form.
5. Register two international referee professors who receive online recommendation requests.
7. Board of the Science@Leuven Fund evaluates dossiers.
8. Receive final award decisions in April/May.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Direct application via KU Leuven admissions application tool + separate Science@Leuven portal submission.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees using the Science@Leuven online reference template.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Explain your academic ambitions, reason for choosing KU Leuven Faculty of Science, and describe a scientific problem you wish to investigate.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for Master's; concise description of thesis research interests within the motivation statement.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing science competitions, lab internships, programming skills, and grades.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Select candidates may be invited for an online video interview by the scholarship committee.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE Subject tests in Physics/Math/Chemistry are optional but viewed favorably.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Original transcripts and degree certificate attested by HEC and MOFA upon arrival.

required_documents_checklist.specification: PDF proof showing submitted application to Faculty of Science program
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Generated from KU Leuven admissions tool

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for 16-year education with grading scale
Completed via Science@Leuven referee portal by university professors
Official English test score meeting Faculty of Science requirements

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Strict single annual intake; missing February 15 forfeits scholarship eligibility.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 60% (Undergraduate transcript grades and scientific coursework rigor)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Board of the Science@Leuven Fund and senior professors of the Faculty of Science.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Eligibility verification -> Departmental ranking of academic transcripts & references -> Joint Science@Leuven committee decision.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~2,500 applicants to Faculty of Science programs
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in theoretical physics, mathematics, or biotechnology with top class percentiles, international Olympiad or research background, and outstanding reference letters.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Exceptional Pakistani scholars from Quaid-i-Azam University, NUST, and LUMS in Physics, Astronomy, and Statistics.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: India, China, United States, Italy, Greece, Iran, Turkey, Canada, Pakistan.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Official application fee is strictly €75 paid directly to KU Leuven via flywire/credit card.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: KU Leuven does not employ external recruiters or agencies.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Belgian federal administrative visa processing fee (€220 / ~PKR 67,000)
Initial living deposit required prior to first scholarship disbursement (~€1,000)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: You can apply for any KU Leuven master's program. (Truth: This scholarship is strictly restricted to Faculty of Science programs).
MYTH: IELTS 6.5 is acceptable. (Truth: KU Leuven Faculty of Science strictly mandates IELTS 7.0 overall with no component below 6.5).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party websites describe it as open until April; the strict cutoff for non-EEA students applying for Science@Leuven is February 15.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: To secure Year 2 renewal, the student must complete Year 1 with the distinction 'Cum Laude' (Distinction, at least 68% average).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory full-time attendance in all course modules and research laboratories.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Passing all 60 ECTS credits of Year 1 before September.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Permitted to work up to 20 hours per week during term time under Belgian student permit.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; eligible for Belgium's 1-year orientation search year (zoekjaar) after graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: If student fails to achieve distinction in Year 1, Year 2 funding is cancelled.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Switching master's programs terminates the scholarship immediately.

official_sources_verified.source_name: KU Leuven - Science@Leuven Scholarship Official Portal
